(ii) Community Infrastructure: Residents squatting on crown lands in the Mt. Pandy area of South

St. George were relocated to rocky, hilly terrain in La Sagesse, St. David's and Beausejour, in

North West St. George, where preparation for the relocation could be said to have begun in 2006,

[Context: North West St. George, where preparation for the relocation could be said to have begun in 2006,]
continued throughout 2007 and culminating with all residents relocated by the end of 2008.

Residents were essentially given tenuous housing with no infrastructure such as roads,

embankment walls and drains in their new locations. They are thus vulnerable to damage to

housing foundation during heavy rainfall which may cause land slippage, landslides and stone

movement while unable to receive immediate emergency services because of absence of

motorable roads.
